full_judgment:
Siddiqur Rahman Miah J: This Rule was issued on an application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed by the accused- petitioners, calling upon the opposite-party to show cause as to why the proceedings of GR case No. 17 of 2007 corresponding to Boalmari PS case No. 08 dated 15-2-2007 under section 420/406/109 of the Penal Code now pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Faridpur should not be quashed. 

 2. The facts relevant for the disposal of the Rule, in short, are that on 15-2-2007 one SI Mozibor Rahman, Sub-Inspector, Boalmari PS, Faridpur lodged a written ejahar with Boalmari PS alleging inter alia, that one Major Atfab Ahmed, informed on 13-2-2007 the informant over mobile that some CI sheets were recovered from different houses and Hasamdia United High School, and as per request of Major, the informant along with some police constables appeared at the place of occurrence and found that some accused persons were arrested by the major Aftab Ahmed and a good number of CI sheets were recovered from the house of different persons and also from the local Hashamida United High school. On quarry, the informant came to learn that the seized tins were relief tin. The ten accused-persons misappropriated those CI sheets on using the same in their homestead. Later on upazila project implementation officer after scrutiny informed that 26 pieces of CI sheets were lawfully allots in the name of accused Siraj Sikder. But 16 pieces CI sheets were recovered from accused Siraj Sikder on which the seals were covered by silver colour paint which indicates that the accused- persons have committed offence under section 420/ 406/109 of the Penal Code. Hence the present case. 

 5. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the impugned proceedings of GR case No. 17 of 2007 corresponding to Boalmari PS case No. 08 dated 15-2-2007 under sections 420/406/109 of the Penal Code now pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Faridpur, the petitioners moved this miscellaneous case under section 561A of the Code of Criminal procedure before this Court for quashing the proceedings. 

 7. He cited the decisions in the case of Habibur Rahman Mollah (Ex-Member of parliament) vs State reported in 62 DLR (AD) 233, in the case of Md Musa vs Kabir Ahmed, reported in 1989 BLD (AD) 118 and in the case of Md. Islam Ali Mia @ Md Islam vs Amal Chandra Mondal reported in 13 BLD (AD) 28 in support of his contention. 

 8. Mr. KM Zahid Sarwar, the learned Deputy Attorney-General for the state opposing the Rule submits that the prima facie case has been made out against the petitioners so the case cannot be quashed without taking evidence and, as such, the proceeding of the case is not liable to be quashed. 

 10. We find good deal of force in the above submission of the learned Advocate for the petitioners that the allegations made in the FIR that the petitioners got 26 sheets of tin of relief for the construction his dwelling hut, which were recovered and seized by the police, even if are taken its face value and accepted in their entirety do not constitute an offence punishable under sections 406/420 of the Penal Code. It is not the case that the seized tin sheets were entrusted with the petitioner for distribution as relief goods which they misappropriated using the same for his own consumption. So the alleged act of the petitioners do not attract section 406 of the Penal Code. There is no application of section 420 of the Penal Code against the petitioners as there is no allegation that they obtained the tin sheet fraudulently inducing anybody to part with the same to him. Moreover, the proceeding cannot continue against the petitioner alone as the abettor of the offence of criminal breach of trust punishable under section 406 of the Penal Code without the principal offender of such offence. Thus surely continuation of the case would be sheer harassment of the petitioners and therefore, it is abuse of the process of the Court, to prevent which the proceeding should be quashed in exercising the inherent power of this Court conferred under section 561A of the Code of criminal procedure. 

 The proceedings of GR case No. 17 of 2007 corresponding to Boalmari PS case No. 08 dated 15-2-2007 under section 420/406/109 of the Penal Code now pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Faridpur is hereby quashed.
